# Megsy AI

> Megsy AI is an AI agent workspace made by an Egyptian company. You can chat, search the web, run research, make images and videos, create slides and documents, build simple websites, and run agents that use a browser. It works in English and Egyptian Arabic.

## Key facts

- Product: Megsy AI (https://www.megsyai.com)
- Company: Egyptian company; payments in EGP, including Vodafone Cash through Kashier
- Chat: free
- Credits: images cost 2 credits, videos cost 25 credits, agent tasks cost 1 to 50 credits
- Paid plans unlock media generation and more credits; see Pricing
- Languages: English and Egyptian Arabic (ar-eg)
- Support: support@megsyai.com

## What you can do

- Chat and ask questions (free)
- Web search and deep research reports
- Image generation and video generation (paid plans, uses credits)
- Slides, documents and simple websites
- Agents that open a browser and finish tasks step by step; you approve before an agent is created
- Reminders and tasks inside the Android app

## Who it is for

Students, freelancers, small businesses and teams in Egypt and the Arab world who want one place for AI work in Arabic and English.
